entries.name: adoption-map.md
entries.title: AI Adoption Map
entries.summary: How this repository is itself built with AI. The assets it ships are the product and are described in .devbook/arc42 and .devbook/domain; what follows is only how the work gets done here. The practices live one chapter each in the stage files; this file is the map.

entries.name: 01-author.md
entries.title: 1. Author
entries.summary: Writing an asset: an agent, a skill, an instruction file, a hook, a chapter. The stage every change here starts in.

entries.name: 02-deliver.md
entries.title: 2. Deliver
entries.summary: Carrying a change end to end: from a request to a validated commit, in one session or across several.

entries.name: 03-verify.md
entries.title: 3. Verify
entries.summary: Checking that an asset does what it says: that a skill triggers when it should, that an agent loads, that a chapter parses.
